cpu_comparison.interpretation: On the Mali-G610 (Valhall), the GPU now matches or beats the 4-thread A76 CPU on all three channel-wise primitives. The GPU kernel code was improved since the initial measurement (commit 048aa7e): matrix notation fixes (4cc1cba, d60220c) resolved correctness issues that also affected code generation. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: GPU timing is device-side profiling (excludes host<->device data transfer); CPU timing is wall-clock. For sustained decode where the state matrix persists on-GPU, transfer overhead amortizes.

prior_measurement.note: Original measurement before kernel code improvements. Scan was 164.7us (2.9x slower than current). CumDecay was 43.8us (1.4x slower). The conclusion 'GPU slower than CPU for all three' was correct at that commit but is no longer valid.
prior_measurement.old_conclusion: GPU slower than CPU for all three kernels
prior_measurement.new_conclusion: GPU matches or beats CPU on all three kernels (device-side profiling)

o6_transferability.target_gpu: Immortalis-G720 (Arm 5th gen, CIX P1 / Orion O6)
o6_transferability.shader_code: Identical OpenCL C source transfers — same kernel language, same algorithm. Only performance conclusion is O6-gated per ADR 0005.
o6_transferability.expected: The G720 has significantly more shader cores and higher clock than G610. The heterogeneous mapping (PLAN.md 3.1) may place GDN scan on GPU on the O6 even though CPU wins on t3.
